title: feat(checkout): Support loyalty discounts and voucher redemption [PAY-204]
author: alex-dev
body:
## Summary
Implements customer loyalty tier discounts and voucher code integration for the checkout pipeline.

Closes **PAY-204**.

### Changes
- Added `CustomerTier` enums and data models in `models.py`.
- Implemented `DiscountService.calculate_discount` with tier rate mapping.
- Added unit tests in `test_discount_service.py`.

CC: @sarah-pm @alex-lead
